text: In the Jewish ghetto of medieval Prague, Rabbi Loew reads disaster in the stars as the Emperor orders his people out before the new moon. To defend them he [shapes a giant of clay|origin|monsters people made] and wakes it with a word from the spirit Astaroth, sealed in an amulet on its chest. When his jealous assistant finds Miriam with the squire Florian, the Golem [falls under Astaroth's influence|threat|being taken over], [hurls Florian from the roof|wrong|love betrayed] and [sets the house burning|images|fire, smoke and burning].
